definition: Post-hoc descriptive auxiliary metric requested after primary audits; not the preregistered world reproduction criterion. No change to frozen audits, classifiers or raw.

Unique unit is (phase,trial,normal-hand action). Union=worldOpened OR informationPanelOpened in existing bounded responseMoments. Same action counted once; overlap reported explicitly. First and wb hands excluded exactly as frozen normal-hand flag. This does not label all information openings as unintended or equivalent in severity to world.
Response moments remain bounded by next input or60s. All incomplete and normal-hand incomplete windows retained. No observed union is not proof of no later opening.

Point proxy is first observed visible,center-unobscured positive display from existing samples/pointChanges; not precise reward/paint time. Goal is first recorded positive stored goal count from existing merged snapshots, not necessarily visible presentation. No observation is not a zero completion time.

Same viewport/CPU/holds/input policy but random state,routes,exposures and timestamps differ; no physical-device, causal usability or retention-rate conclusion. Report primary single runs separately. No new observer/browser/test/HTTP.
